CheckTitle: Security Groups with Elasticsearch/Kibana ports (9200, 9300, 5601) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to Elasticsearch/Kibana ports.
Risk: Open Elasticsearch ports (e.g., 9200, 9300) can lead to data deletion, ransomware, or sensitive information theft, as clusters are frequently indexed by search engines and exploited.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
